adjudication.rationale: In packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` is defined with computed property keys `[z.string().toString()]` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]`. In JS/TS this evaluates immediately to string keys like `"[object Object]"` (and similar), not a Zod “catch-all” rule. As a result, in sync mode (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`) `safeParse(response)` will generally fail unless the response literally contains those bogus property names, breaking token parsing/refresh flows that rely on this.
